REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JUNE 10, 2004 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.

3.

4.

5.

Public Comments and Suggestions
Consent Calendar
7.
Registers of Demands dated 6/10/2004
8.
Treasurer's Reports for period ending 4/30/2004
9.
Minutes of 5/27/2004
10.
Ordinance for second reading and adoption. Reading of ordinance waived and ordinance adopted.
10A.
Ordinance 885 – An Ordinance of the City of Cerritos amending Title 20, Chapter 20.30, Section 20.30.470 of the Cerritos Municipal Code Changing the Definition of Landscaping to restrict the use of inorganic and artificial materials in landscape designs
11.
Public Hearings
11A.
A resolution of the Cerritos City Council approving a proposal for the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency to use tax increment funds to pay the cost of construction of a transit station to serve Avalon at Cerritos and authorizing the execution of a Transit Station Agreement with the Cerritos Community College District and the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency.
A resolution of the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency authorizing the execution of a Transit Station Agreement with the Cerritos Community College District and the City of Cerritos.
A joint resolution of the Cerritos City Council and Cerritos Redevelopment Agency adopting a Negative Declaration for a transit station to be located at the Cerritos Community College campus
11B.
Consideration of the continuation of the Los Coyotes Lighting and Landscaping District.
A resolution of the City Council of the City of Cerritos, ordering a reassessment within the Los Coyotes Lighting and Landscaping District, confirming the findings of the Engineer's Report, providing for improvements to the maintenance of and the furnishing of electric current and landscaping to the Los Coyotes Lighting and Landscaping District, and ordering the remittance of assessments from reserves in the Los Coyotes Lighting and Landscaping Fund and other available revenues
12.
Public Works Activities
12A.
Consideration of various alternatives for the design of medians on 166th Street between Carmenita Road and Marquardt Avenue, Project No. 13022
13.

14.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports
15.
